messages:
maria: :rotating_light: CSM reported a regression in p99 for AcmeCorp when using function-calling + structured JSON validation. p95 looks fine, p99 jumped from ~420ms -> ~980ms since the validator change last night. attaching logs.
jamal: Can you paste the logs and a simple repro? Is this for tool router or function-call path?
maria: Logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T22:03:12Z router.request_id=rc-12345 route=/v1/generate model=rw-xx validator=on total_ms=982 validation_ms=241 kvcache_ms=12 serve_ms=729
2026-03-15T22:03:12Z validator.schema_id=fn_schema_47 compile_ms=3 run_ms=238 path=/tools/execute
```
maria: Repro curl we used (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"input":"call_tool","tools":[{"name":"execute","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"params":{"type":"object"}}},"call":{"name":"execute","arguments":{"id":"123","params":{"a":1}}}}]}'
```
alex: That validation_ms=241 stands out. The validator is synchronous on the request path; if the schema is large (deeply nested/regex checks) AJV-like validators can add hundred+ ms at p99. Did we switch to strict mode or enable full JSON schema draft-2020 checks in the last deploy?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Deployed rti/validator-service v2.1 to prod at 2026-03-15T21:58:40Z (changes: strict-schema-enforcement, regex-sanitizer)
jamal: OK that aligns. Quick mitigations: (1) flip strict-schema flag for affected customer to false, (2) route them to the pre-validator variant (route: no-validate-tool), (3) enable sampling-based validation (validate 1% for now) so we reduce p99 impact while still catching regressions.
olivia: Agree. We should also communicate rollback window to CSM. CSM asked for ETA on mitigation.
maria: I can flip feature-flag per-customer. CLI to toggle:
```
redwood-admin feature-flag set --customer acme --flag strict_schema_validation --value false
```
jamal: For longer term: (a) compile schemas to optimized functions (AJV compile cache + precompiled validator per schema-id), (b) move heavy checks async: accept and emit tool-call, run schema checks in background and emit a validation event (failures retried or alerted), (c) add short-circuit checks (simple shape prefilter) before running full schema engine.
alex: Also add a small in-memory LRU cache keyed by schemaHash + inputPrefixHash for validated shapes. Many tool-calls are repeated; cache hits eliminate validator run entirely.
maria: I'll flip the flag now and report back. Also opening incident ticket and adding p99 monitoring for validation_ms per-route.
ops-bot: incident-bot: Created INC-2026-1374 -> "Validation-induced p99 spike (Acme)" assigned to eng-runtime.
jamal: I'll draft a quick canary rollback PR to revert strict-mode by end of day. Also will add a config gate to run validator off the critical path (async) behind a flag.
olivia: Communication plan: Maria + CSM to notify Acme that we're applying a temporary mitigation and will keep them updated. Postmortem to include telemetry (validation_ms, cache_hit_ratio, schema_size).
maria: Done: flag toggled; initial telemetry shows validation_ms p99 dropped to ~60ms within 5 minutes and total p99 back to ~430ms. CSM updated.
alex: Follow-ups: PR for precompile cache, add per-schema compile metrics, and add a feature to route to "no-validate" fallback for trusted customers. I'll own the PR.
jamal: Assigning tasks: alex -> precompile/cache PR, jamal -> canary rollback PR + async plan, maria -> customer comms + incident doc. Target: tomorrow EOD for initial PRs.
olivia: Thanks team. Keep thread updated if p99 resurges. :thumbsup:
